chunks: Therefore, beware of yourself, beware of yourself!

Allāh has already shown you your way, and the end where your affairs will terminate. You are speeding towards the aim of loss and the position of unbelief. Your ego has pushed you towards evil, thrown you into misguidance, conveyed you to destruction, and created difficulties in your way.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the ego leading to loss in his letter to Muawiya?
ai.summary: In this epistle to Muawiya, Imam Ali (AS) diagnoses the root of political deviation as the tyranny of the ego (nafs al-ammara), which has led Muawiya from clear guidance into the depths of spiritual ruin. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that internal moral decay precedes external political failure, urging a return to divine clarity amidst worldly ambition. The warning underscores the concept of 'khusr' (loss) not merely as defeat, but as a state of being entrenched in kufr (unbelief) through self-deception.
